*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:transparent}
html{font-size:1.25vw}
body{min-height:100vh;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;font-synthesis:none}
.osb-core-fields{display:none!important}
.point-slot:has(>.isMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"])>.isGamePoint{opacity:0!important}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
.combinedAName:empty::before{content:"Team A"}.combinedBName:empty::before{content:"Team B"}
.teamAName:empty::before{content:"Team A"}.teamBName:empty::before{content:"Team B"}
.nm{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;overflow-wrap:normal;word-break:normal;hyphens:none;text-wrap:balance}
.slab{position:relative;flex:none;overflow:hidden}.slab>.jc{position:absolute;inset:0}
.diamond{position:relative;display:block;flex:none;width:var(--d,3rem);height:calc(var(--d,3rem)*.74)}
.diamond>.base{position:absolute;width:calc(var(--d,3rem)*.25);height:calc(var(--d,3rem)*.25);transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--base-off,transparent);border:var(--base-line,.12rem) solid var(--base-edge,currentColor);border-radius:var(--base-r,.08rem);overflow:hidden}
.diamond>.base.second{left:37.5%;top:calc(var(--d,3rem)*.06)}.diamond>.base.third{left:7%;top:calc(var(--d,3rem)*.39)}.diamond>.base.first{left:68%;top:calc(var(--d,3rem)*.39)}
.diamond .runner{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--base-on,#f5cf52)}
.diamond>.base:has(>.runner[style*="opacity: 1"]){border-color:var(--base-on,#f5cf52);box-shadow:0 0 calc(var(--d,3rem)*.1) var(--base-on,#f5cf52)}
.dots{display:flex;gap:var(--dot-gap,.25rem)}
.dot{position:relative;flex:none;width:var(--dot,.82rem);height:var(--dot,.82rem);border-radius:50%;background:var(--dot-off,rgba(255,255,255,.18))}
.dot>.lit{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dot-on,#f5cf52)}
.half{position:relative;display:inline-block;flex:none;vertical-align:middle}
.half-dim{position:absolute;inset:0}
.half-dim::before,.half-dim::after,.inningHalf::before,.inningHalf::after{content:"";background:var(--half-off,rgba(255,255,255,.25))}
.half-dim::before,.half-dim::after{position:absolute;left:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.half-dim::before,.inningHalf::after{clip-path:polygon(50% 6%,94% 42%,6% 42%)}
.half-dim::after,.inningHalf::before{clip-path:polygon(6% 58%,94% 58%,50% 94%)}
.half-win{position:relative;display:block;width:3ch;height:var(--half-h,1.2rem);overflow:hidden;font-family:Menlo,Consolas,"DejaVu Sans Mono","Liberation Mono",monospace;font-size:var(--half-size,.62rem);font-weight:400;line-height:var(--half-h,1.2rem);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
.inningHalf{display:flex;width:max-content;height:100%;margin-left:-6ch;color:transparent;white-space:pre}
.inningHalf::before,.inningHalf::after{flex:none;width:3ch;height:100%;background:var(--half-on,#fff)}
.inningHalf::before{order:1}.inningHalf::after{order:2}
.st{position:relative;display:inline-grid;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.st>*{grid-area:1/1}
.st-pre{opacity:0}.st:has(>.isMatchStarted[style*="opacity: 0"])>.st-pre{opacity:1}
.st-live-in{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45em}.st-live-in>i{flex:none;width:.9rem;height:.9rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--live,#ff3b30);box-shadow:0 0 .45rem var(--live,#ff3b30);animation:osb-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes osb-pulse{50%{opacity:.7}}
.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .st-pre,.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .st-live-in{visibility:hidden}
body:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .isMatchStarted{opacity:0!important}
.ls{display:flex}
.ls-col{position:relative}
.ls-extra{display:none!important}.ls-extra:has(>.ls-gate[style*="opacity: 1"]){display:flex!important}
.ls-gate{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative}
.ls-cur{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.board{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed","Bahnschrift SemiCondensed","Roboto Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;color:#fff;background:transparent;--live:#e5262d;--optic:#d4f53c;--violet:#22175a;--deep:#170f40;--row:#2a1f66;--ink:#1d1638;--mute:#cfc8ee;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.1);--xtra:#3d2f8f}
.sb{width:72rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:1rem;overflow:hidden;background:var(--violet);box-shadow:0 .8rem 2.2rem rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.1rem;min-width:0;padding:1.1rem 1.6rem;background:var(--deep);border-bottom:.3rem solid var(--optic)}
.tag{flex:none;padding:.5rem 1rem;border-radius:2rem;background:var(--optic);color:var(--ink);font:700 1.35rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em}
.ev{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:.2rem;flex:1;min-width:0;text-transform:uppercase}
.ev-e{font:700 1.7rem/1.08 "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed","Bahnschrift SemiCondensed","Roboto Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.02em;overflow-wrap:normal;hyphens:none}.ev-r{font:700 1.2rem/1.1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute)}
.ev-e:empty,.ev-r:empty{display:none}
.badge{flex:none;display:grid;align-items:center;justify-items:end}.badge>*{grid-area:1/1}
.badge .st{justify-items:end;font:700 1.35rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em}
.badge .st-pre{padding:.5rem .95rem;border-radius:2rem;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .14rem rgba(255,255,255,.55);color:#fff}
.badge .st-live{padding:.5rem 1rem;border-radius:2rem;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.badge .isComplete{padding:.5rem 1.1rem;border-radius:2rem;background:var(--optic);color:var(--ink);font:700 1.35rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em}
.main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.9rem;padding:1.2rem 1.6rem 1.6rem}
/* the line score */
.lsw{display:flex;border-radius:.6rem;overflow:hidden;background:var(--deep)}
.ls-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:2.6rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#f1eefc;font:700 1.45rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif}
.names{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--row)}
.nmc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;height:5.4rem;padding-right:1rem}
.nmc+.nmc{border-top:.1rem solid var(--line)}
.nmc>.slab{align-self:stretch;width:.9rem}
.slab{background:var(--fb)}.slab-a{--fb:#4f7be0}.slab-b{--fb:#e0583a}
.nmw{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;padding-left:.4rem}
.krow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;min-height:1.9rem}
.kk{display:grid;font:700 1.2rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}.kk>*{grid-area:1/1}
.kk>.kv{opacity:0}
.lsw:has(.isBHome[style*="opacity: 1"]) .nm-a .kv,.lsw:has(.isAHome[style*="opacity: 1"]) .nm-b .kv{opacity:1}
.lsw:not(:has(:is(.isAHome,.isBHome)[style*="opacity: 1"])) .kk{display:none}
.batw{display:grid;place-items:center start}.batw>*{grid-area:1/1}
.bat,.wtag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.38rem .7rem;border-radius:2rem;background:var(--optic);color:var(--ink);font:700 1.15rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.bat::before{content:"";width:.65rem;height:.65rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink)}
.nm{font:700 2.05rem/1.04 "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed","Bahnschrift SemiCondensed","Roboto Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0}
.ls-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:3.5rem;flex:none;border-left:.1rem solid var(--line)}
.ls-c{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:5.4rem;font:700 2.3rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ls-c+.ls-c{border-top:.1rem solid var(--line)}
.ls-cur{background:rgba(212,245,60,.13)}
.ls-col:has(>.ls-cur[style*="opacity: 1"])>.ls-h{background:var(--optic);color:var(--ink)}
.ls-extra{background:rgba(61,47,143,.35)}.ls-extra>.ls-h{background:var(--xtra);color:#fff}
.tot{display:flex;border-left:.25rem solid var(--violet)}
.rcol{flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:6rem}
.rcol>.ls-h{background:var(--optic);color:var(--ink)}
.rt{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:5.4rem;overflow:hidden}
.rt+.rt{border-top:.2rem solid var(--deep)}
.rt>.slab{position:absolute;inset:0;width:auto}
.rt::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(0,0,0,.24))}
.runs{position:relative;z-index:1;font:700 3.3rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 .1rem .4rem rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.rt>.win{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .4rem var(--optic)}
.he-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:4rem;flex:none;border-left:.1rem solid var(--line)}
.v{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:5.4rem;font:700 2.3rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#ece8fb}
.v+.v{border-top:.1rem solid var(--line)}
.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .lsw:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) :is(.nm-b,.rt-b),.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .lsw:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) :is(.nm-a,.rt-a){opacity:.5}
.lsw:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) :is(.ls-c:nth-child(2 of .ls-c),.vb),.lsw:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) :is(.ls-c:nth-child(1 of .ls-c),.va){color:#9d96c2}
/* EXTRA legend, shown once extra innings are played */
.xlg{display:none;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font:700 1.2rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.xlg>i{width:1.4rem;height:1.1rem;border-radius:.2rem;background:var(--xtra)}
.sb:has(.ls-extra>.ls-gate[style*="opacity: 1"]) .xlg{display:flex}
/* the situation strip: four clusters sized to their content */
.bot{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2.6rem;height:7rem;padding:0 1.6rem;border-radius:.6rem;background:var(--row)}
.z{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem}
.z+.z{padding-left:2.6rem;border-left:.12rem solid var(--line)}
.zl{font:700 1.3rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.inn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;font:700 3.4rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;--half-on:var(--optic);--half-off:rgba(255,255,255,.22);--half-h:3.4rem;--half-size:1.45rem}
.inn-n{min-width:1.1em;text-align:left}
.diamond{--d:6.2rem;--base-edge:rgba(236,233,251,.6);--base-off:rgba(255,255,255,.05);--base-on:var(--optic);--base-line:.18rem}
.count{font:700 3.4rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.count .dash{opacity:.6;margin:0 .06em}
.bs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;--dot:1.4rem;--dot-gap:.3rem;--dot-off:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.bs>span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;font:700 1.4rem/1 "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","D-DIN","Roboto Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;color:#ece8fb}.bs b{width:1.15rem}
